title: David and the Ammonites: The War against Hanun
description: After King Hanun of the Ammonites humiliates David's envoys by shaving off half their beards, he triggers a major war in which Joab and Abishai defeat the Ammonites and their Aramean mercenaries. Later, Hadadezer gathers the Arameans at Helam, but David strikes them down and kills the commander Shobak.
